description: This file defines the ConduitContext class, which is an Entity Framework DbContext for the Conduit application. It specifies DbSet properties for various domain entities such as Articles, Comments, Persons, Tags, and relationship entities. The class configures entity relationships and primary keys in OnModelCreating and provides transaction management methods including BeginTransaction, CommitTransaction, and RollbackTransaction.

classes.name: ConduitContext
classes.description: Entity Framework DbContext class managing database access for the Conduit application, including DbSet properties and transaction control.

methods.name: BeginTransaction
methods.description: Starts a new database transaction if none is active and the database is not in-memory.

methods.name: CommitTransaction
methods.description: Commits the current transaction, handling exceptions and disposing of the transaction object.

methods.name: RollbackTransaction
methods.description: Rolls back the current transaction and disposes of the transaction object.
